result.instructions: Tools for Raklet, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which members have a membership payment due this month?"; "Add Aoife Byrne as a new contact with the language en."; "List the events in our organisation for the next 30 days with their ticket options.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Raklet data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run raklet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run raklet_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run raklet_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. raklet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: raklet_get_account
tools.title: Get the connected organisation
tools.description: Return the organisation the API token belongs to. Use it first to confirm the connection. Raklet API: GET /public/account/me.

tools.name: raklet_list_languages
tools.title: List languages
tools.description: List the language codes Raklet accepts for contacts, for example when creating one. Raklet API: GET /common/languages.

tools.name: raklet_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the organisation's contacts (members), one page at a time. The optional q is a base64-encoded JSON filter in the form Raklet expects. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/contacts.

q.description: Base64-encoded JSON filter (the API's q parameter).

tools.name: raklet_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Return one contact's full details: addresses, emails, phones, education and work history. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/contacts/{organisationMembershipId}/details.

tools.name: raklet_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in the organisation. Writes a member record. Raklet may send the contact an e-mail depending on the organisation's settings. Raklet API: POST /organisations/{organisationId}/contacts.

language.description: Language code from raklet_list_languages, e.g. en. Required.

email.description: Primary e-mail address. Raklet uses it to identify the contact.

member_no.description: Membership number. Raklet generates one when left empty.

tools.name: raklet_list_corporate_members
tools.title: List corporate members
tools.description: List the organisation's corporate members (companies), one page at a time. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/corporateMembers.

tools.name: raklet_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the organisation's contact tags (for example committees or volunteer groups). Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/tags.

tools.name: raklet_get_tag
tools.title: Get a tag
tools.description: Return one tag with its details. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/tags/{id}.

tools.name: raklet_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the organisation's events in a date range. Both dates are required. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/events.

start_date.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

end_date.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

continuation.description: Continuation value from the previous page.

tools.name: raklet_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Return one event's details. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/events/{id}.

tools.name: raklet_list_event_ticket_options
tools.title: List event ticket options
tools.description: List the ticket options (prices and types) of one event. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/events/{id}/ticketoptions.

tools.name: raklet_list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List news posts of the organisation's community feed, one page at a time. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/posts.

tools.name: raklet_get_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Return one news post with its body and status. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/posts/{postId}.

tools.name: raklet_create_post
tools.title: Create a news post
tools.description: Create a news post in the organisation's community feed. Members can read it once it is published. Read the status field of the reply to see whether it is a draft or published. Raklet API: POST /organisations/{organisationId}/posts.

tools.name: raklet_list_membership_plans
tools.title: List membership plans
tools.description: List the organisation's membership plans and their prices. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/plans.

tools.name: raklet_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List the organisation's membership subscriptions (which contact holds which plan). Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/subscriptions.

tools.name: raklet_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List the membership payments recorded for the organisation. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/payments.

tools.name: raklet_list_debts
tools.title: List debts
tools.description: List the outstanding debts (amounts a contact still owes) recorded for the organisation. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/debts.

tools.name: raklet_list_donations
tools.title: List donations
tools.description: List the donations recorded for the organisation. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/donations.

tools.name: raklet_list_applications
tools.title: List membership applications
tools.description: List the membership application form submissions, one page at a time. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/applications.

tools.name: raklet_get_organisation_settings
tools.title: Get organisation settings
tools.description: Return the organisation's settings (name, portal and membership options). Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/settings.

tools.name: raklet_list_action_logs
tools.title: List action logs
tools.description: List the organisation's action log: who changed what and when. Filter by date range, action or contact. Raklet API: GET /app/actionlogs.

continuation.description: Continuation value from the previous page.

start_date.description: Inclusive lower bound on the record time, ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

end_date.description: Inclusive upper bound on the record time, ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Raklet
prompts.description: What you can do with Raklet here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_a_member_and_read_the_full_record
prompts.title: Find a member and read the full record
prompts.description: List the contacts one page at a time. Then read one contact's addresses, emails, phones, education and work history. List the tags to find a group.

prompts.name: check_membership_payments_and_debts
prompts.title: Check membership payments and debts
prompts.description: List which contact holds which membership plan, the payments recorded, and the debts a contact still owes.

prompts.name: review_events_and_their_ticket_options
prompts.title: Review events and their ticket options
prompts.description: List events in a date range. Open one event and read the prices and types of its ticket options.

prompts.name: review_applications_and_the_action_log
prompts.title: Review applications and the action log
prompts.description: List membership application submissions. Read the action log to see who changed what and when, filtered by date or contact.

prompts.name: add_a_new_member_contact
prompts.title: Add a new member contact
prompts.description: List the language codes Raklet accepts, then create a contact. Raklet may send the contact an e-mail, depending on the organisation's settings.

prompts.name: create_a_news_post_for_the_community_feed
prompts.title: Create a news post for the community feed
prompts.description: List the existing news posts, then create a new one. Read the status in the reply to see whether it is a draft or published.
